race.comment: BASSETT HOUND (3) lobs in a very winnable race after jumping a $3.60 chance in a G3 last start. He didn't have the best of luck as he was working into the race but lost no admirers. Gets the winkers on now and although he'd be a winning hope in the Winterbottom later, this looks a handy consolation for connections. TWISTED STEEL (2) has been solid in G3 company this campaign, finishing just ahead of BASSETT HOUND last start when up on the speed throughout. He should be at his peak third-up into the campaign with Shinn's booking a good push for his chances. HURRICANE HARLEY (5) jumped favourite last start and closed nicely on the 7-day turnaround. Galati reunites with him today and he's sure to be closing strongly. XENTARO (10) was solid fresh and then had no luck behind September Born last start in the same race as HURRICANE HARLEY. Maps beautifully and can fire third-up. SNITZALATTE (6) has to be included after a good last start effort, with the inside draw a positive.
